maria: Quick check-in — ran a 4TP x 8PP 1F1B run (seq=64, microbatches=8) after the kernel selector change. Observed ~18% PP bubble deadspace on host-3. Uploading a short perf slice and nvprof extract. cc @ajay @lex

ajay: can you paste the flamegraph / perf numbers here?

maria: pasted below — trimmed. main anomaly is tail variance on matmul kernels and spikes in all-reduce start times. Also kvcache miss rate looks up on host-3 (~12% vs 3% on others).

maria: ```
summary:
  pp_bubble_idle_pct: 0.18
  avg_allreduce_ms: 1.9
  allreduce_tail_95th_ms: 4.8
  matmul_kernel_var_ms: 0.6 (sigma)
  kvcache_miss_rate_host3: 0.12
  kvcache_miss_rate_host1: 0.03
  microbatch_size: 8
  seq_len: 64
```

lex: interesting — two hypotheses: (1) kernel selector is falling back to a slower kernel variant on host-3 for certain shapes (look for different kernel names in the nvprof), (2) KV cache thrash causing extra memory ops and delaying the compute window so allreduce scheduling misaligns.

maria: nvprof snippet shows alternating kernels: "gemm_fast_q8" and sometimes "gemm_generic_f32" on steps where matmul latency spikes.

lex: that points at selector jitter. we added a heuristic to pick quantized kernel when estimated error < 0.7 but we didn't account for headroom on certain batch dims. If selector oscillates between kernels across microbatches you get tail noise -> PP bubble.

dan: also note all-reduce timing depends on when the last tensor is ready. if one microbatch gets the generic kernel occasionally it postpones its reduce and the next PP stage waits. overlap fails.

sophie: quick experiment idea: run two variants on the same node cluster: (A) force kernel pin to quantized for the problematic shapes (selector override), (B) increase microbatches to 12 to amortize random spikes. see impact on bubble pct and p95 latency.

maria: ran a quick pin test: forcing quantized reduced pp_bubble_idle to 12% but introduced small quality diffs in outputs for synthetic eval. microbatches=12 reduced bubble to 8% but end-to-end p95 grew ~14ms.

ajay: tradeoff is expected. We should try softer fixes before changing microbatching: 1) selector hysteresis (sticky choice for N microbatches), 2) pre-warm kernels on cold hosts to avoid falling back, 3) reduce kvcache eviction churn.

maria: good list. I profiled kvcache on host-3 — eviction rate spikes aligned with some model steps (likely background housekeeping). suspect memalloc pattern differences on that GPU.

perf-bot: new trace uploaded -> https://perf.redwood.local/traces/1765556789/ (flamegraph + allreduce timeline) :chart_with_upwards_trend:

lex: concrete plan:
  - (today) add selector hysteresis: sticky for 3 microbatches, measure tail variance.
  - (today) run kernel warmup sweep during model init (3 dummy inits) and compare.
  - (tomorrow) run microbatch=10 and microbatch=12 A/B on canary pool; collect pp_bubble_idle, p50/p95, kv_miss, output-delta.
  - (next week) if kvcache evictions still spike, instrument allocator + schedule kvcache GC at quiet points.

dan: also let's add instrumentation to the all-reduce scheduler to log start/ready deltas per microbatch — that'll let us quantify overlap loss. small patch ready, can deploy to canary.

maria: pushed a PR for selector hysteresis (WIP) and added a flag --force-kernel to repro. linking in thread. I'll kick off microbatch A/B runs once PR is on canary.

sophie: thanks. if hysteresis helps, we should default to sticky=2 for 1F1B for now and iterate. keep the pinned-run results handy for the QA micro-eval to check output drift.

ajay: good. assign owners: maria -> selector hysteresis + runs; dan -> all-reduce ready-delta logging; lex -> kvcache GC investigation; sophie -> eval harness for output-delta checks. update here when you have canary numbers.

maria: noted. starting runs now. will report within ~2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
